episodes.synopsis: This is the country Hinomoto. Thanks to revolutionary new technologies, the country flourished and the economy boomed. However, overshadowed by those advances, the railroad was losing significance and drifted into obscurity. There are beings called Railord. They are humanoid or doll-like control modules for railroad trains and are responsible for assisting with the safe operation of the railroad. Time passes and it is now the year 1989, Ohitoyo City in Kyuushuu's Kumamoto prefecture...
episodes.title: Opening of the Raillord Summit

episodes.synopsis: The Raillords have gathered with the goal of restoring the railroad's relevance. They begin discussions to gather ideas on how to bring on a new era for the railroad.
episodes.title: The Breakout Groups of Destiny

episodes.synopsis: In order to bring about a new age of the railroad, the Raillords gathered in Ohitoyo City and came to the decision to produce merchandise. The brainstorming breakout sessions are about to begin!
episodes.title: The Breakout Sessions Begin

episodes.synopsis: Suzushiro, Iyo, and Riiko are in deep discussions about what merchandise to produce. But the insect lover Riiko is too distracted as she wants to go look for bugs...
episodes.title: Cloth Items and Bugs

episodes.synopsis: The second breakout session has begun. Beni is psyched because she wants to win against Reina. On the other hand, finished with their session, Iyo and Riiko are checking out Ohitoyo City's sights!
episodes.title: Eternal Rival

episodes.synopsis: When it's Beni's turn to come up with an idea for merchandise, she has a spark of inspiration! Meanwhile, Shirogane and Ran get almost too excited while visiting a local train souvenir shop...
episodes.title: The Heated Rivalry

episodes.synopsis: Breakout session #3 begins. First up is Ran, an extremely popular Raillord, nicknamed "Prince of Raillords"! Meanwhile Kiko and Beni, who are done with their session, make their way to a blacksmith.
episodes.title: Topstar Makes an Appearance

episodes.synopsis: In order to bring about a new era of the railroad, Ran and Shirogane continue working on merch ideas. Meanwhile, Kakaa and Suika's sightseeing takes them to Ohitoyo City's castle.
episodes.title: The One Who Travels Through Tunnels

episodes.synopsis: Having finished their sightseeing trip around Ohitoyo City, the last merch breakout session with Kakaa and Suika begins. Meanwhile, having finished theirs, Ran and Shirogane go visit the coal mine...
episodes.title: The Famous Kakaa Appears

episodes.synopsis: The Raillords are now in the final stages of coming up with merchandise ideas.
episodes.title: Blooming Fans

episodes.synopsis: The Raillords' breakout sessions, meant to bring about a new age of the railroad, have finished without incident. After that, all of the Raillords go and...
episodes.title: The Soothing Hot Springs

episodes.synopsis: The Raillord Summit has been successfully concluded. To wrap things up, the Raillords all go out one last time to promote the upcoming Maitetsu Festival.
episodes.title: Departure! Onwards!
